2 CHRONICLES CHAPTER 18

Jehoshaphat, joined in affinity with Ahab, is persuaded to go with him against Ramoth-gilead, 2Ch 18:1-3.

Ahab, seduced by false prophets, according to the word of Micaiah, is slain there, 2Ch 18:4-34.
e: For Jehoram, his eldest son, married Athaliah, Ahab’s daughter, 2Ch 21:6; 2Ki 8:18. This chapter is for substance the same with 1Ki 22, where it is explained.
